profile.headline: Senior Software Developer
profile.summary: Experienced professional  focused on achieving strategic goals and delivering quality software solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed middleware and user interfaces to support the Oracle Flash Storage System FS1. Worked on numerous projects focused on integrating the FS with a variety of industry tools and environments, and allowing configuration, management and monitoring. Both led and participated in groups tasked with developing specific tools to integrate the FS with customer defined environments.
* Block storage services targeted for the Oracle Cloud (IaaS, SaaS, and DbaaS). Java.
* OpsTools for integrating the FS1 into the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Java.
* GUI for managing and monitoring FS1, including overall system status, component status, and performing Guided Maintenance, using REST API. Javascript and Oracle JET Framework.
* Proof of concept tool to prove ability to replace ZFS solution and integrate the FS management tools into OCI. Python.
* Enterprise Manager plugin, UI integrating FS1 in the Oracle stack.. Enterprise Manager provides market-leading management and automation support for Oracle applications, databases, middleware, hardware and engineered systems. C++.
* VMWare plugin for FS integration with VMWare tools and environments. Java.
* Data Protection UI to coordinate configuring automated data backup and restoration. C++.
* CLI for FS configuration management. Perl.
